{"dataset_name":"online_shoppers","model_family":"linear_svm","schema_generator":"gpt-5.5-pro","schema_version":"1.0.0","features":[{"name":"page_value_log_norm","type":"formula","description":"Log-scaled PageValues normalized by the training-fold maximum to compress the heavy tail.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"commercial_value","expected_model_benefit":"Provides a smooth high-value axis for a linear margin without letting extreme PageValues dominate.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.clip(np.log1p(PageValues) / np.log1p(361.7637419), 0.0, balance between ExitRates and BounceRates; values above 0.5 indicate exits exceed bounces.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"navigation_friction","expected_model_benefit":"Captures directional friction shape beyond the average rate, adding another useful linear coordinate.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.clip((ExitRates - BounceRates + 0.2) / 0.4, 0.0, 1.0)"},{"name":"value_friction_contrast","type":"formula","description":"Signed contrast between log-scaled PageValues strength and combined navigation friction.","value_range":[-1.0,1.0],"feature_family":"value_friction_projection","expected_model_benefit":"Creates an approximate value-minus-friction projection that can directly support a wide-margin boundary.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.clip(np.log1p(PageValues) / np.log1p(361.7637419), 0.0, 1.0) - np.clip((BounceRates + ExitRates) / 0.4, 0.0, 1.0)"},{"name":"value_low_friction_composite","type":"formula","description":"Product of log-scaled PageValues strength and the complement of combined navigation friction.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"value_friction_projection","expected_model_benefit":"Highlights sessions where value and low-friction cues align on a bounded scale.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.clip(np.log1p(PageValues) / np.log1p(361.7637419), 0.0, 1.0) * (1.0 - np.clip((BounceRates + ExitRates) / 0.4, 0.0, 1.0))"},{"name":"special_day_norm","type":"formula","description":"SpecialDay clipped to a bounded intensity score for temporal proximity to a special shopping date.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"calendar_context","expected_model_benefit":"Supplies a smooth calendar-nearness feature that can receive a simple linear weight.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.clip(SpecialDay, 0.0, 1.0)"},{"name":"weekend_flag","type":"formula","description":"Numeric indicator for whether the session occurred on a weekend.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"calendar_context","expected_model_benefit":"Keeps weekend behavior as a compact numeric coordinate for linear weighting.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(Weekend == 1, 1.0, 0.0)"},{"name":"visitor_newness_score","type":"formula","description":"Ordered encoding of VisitorType semantics: returning visitor as 0.0, other as 0.5, new visitor as 1.0.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"visitor_context","expected_model_benefit":"Replaces sparse visitor-type indicators with a compact recency-oriented score.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(VisitorType == 'New_Visitor', 1.0, np.where(VisitorType == 'Other', 0.5, 0.0))"},{"name":"month_commercial_season_score","type":"formula","description":"Deterministic ordinal score for Month, emphasizing late-year shopping season and assigning smaller values to earlier months present in the fold.","value_range":[0.0,1.0],"feature_family":"calendar_context","expected_model_benefit":"Gives the margin a single calendar-season axis instead of several sparse month 0.0))))))))))"},{"name":"traffic_source_prevalence_score","type":"formula","description":"Unsupervised commonness score for TrafficType based on training-fold top-value counts scaled to the most np.where((TrafficType == 6) | (TrafficType == '6'), 0.110, np.where((TrafficType == 8) | (TrafficType == '8'), 0.104, np.where((TrafficType == 10) | (TrafficType == '10'), 0.104, np.where((TrafficType
